word: Deep-reading  |  text: One book, read twice, with notes in the margins the second time through. That is your whole method, and it quietly beats the forty skimmed summaries everyone else is stacking. Ask you about it in a year and it is still there, organized and ready.

word: Deep-reading  |  text: People mistake your pace for being behind, right up until they need someone who actually understood the material. Then they come to you. What reads as slow from the outside is your mind refusing to accept anything it has not fully chewed.

word: Takes charge  |  text: You end up in charge wherever the lead is open. Being the one who decides counts for more than being the one who is right, so you speak first and check later. Let someone else go first sometimes, since you do not need the title to lead.

word: Daring  |  text: Moving toward what others edge away from is wiring, and it spares you the weeks other people lose to dread. The feared thing shrinks on contact, every single time, and you have known that longer than most people have been avoiding their own versions of it.

word: Daring  |  text: The call everyone dreaded sat on your list for exactly one day. You made it standing up, between two other tasks, and it went the way these things usually go with you, which is fine. Three weeks of collective dread died in four unremarkable minutes.

word: By the book  |  text: You feel at home inside a system that was there before you arrived. You earn a rank by the rules rather than take one by force, so you wait your turn and expect it to come. Trust the slow route, since you are built for standing that lasts.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/火_正官 · catalyst · ledger[4] (cost self, row 2, The Magistrate (正官)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

word: Squeaky-clean  |  text: The vendor arrived with the usual flexible arrangement and, twelve minutes into your company, quietly stopped offering it. Nothing was said. label: ELEMENT_GOD/火_正官 · catalyst · ledger[5] (cost others, row 2, The Magistrate (正官)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: By the book  |  text: Doing things properly is a respect you pay forward. word: Squeaky-clean  |  text: People confess to you unprompted, at parties, in elevators: small frauds, old guilt, the thing they never told anyone. You never solicit it. label: ELEMENT_GOD/火_正官 · catalyst · ledger[6] (drive, row 3, The Magistrate (正官)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

word: Earns the title  |  text: You want the recognition to be official before you let yourself enjoy it. Because you only fully believe a rank that was signed by someone else, you take the title in writing rather than the thanks in passing. Enjoy the thanks as well, since you are worth something before the paperwork arrives.

label: ELEMENT_GOD/火_正官 · catalyst · ledger[7] (cost self, row 3, The Magistrate (正官)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Inspiring  |  text: A junior colleague told you, three years later, that they had almost quit the field until they watched you handle the audit season with visible integrity and no visible martyrdom. word: Earns the title  |  text: Whenever the title is a step away, you keep its standard and go without its pay. label: ELEMENT_GOD/火_正官 · catalyst · ledger[8] (cost others, row 3, The Magistrate (正官)) · ELEMENT_GOD.fn_reading

options.text: word: Inspiring  |  text: Teams perform above their history when you lead them, and the mechanism is embarrassingly simple: people rise to being trusted the way you trust them, publicly and on the record. Metal is your Body, and running over, it is will with nowhere to go. There is more Metal in you than you spend, so you trust your own standard more than you hear a peer's. You turn every shared stake into a contest, and over time you win more arguments than you keep friends.

options.text: You treat rest as something you earn after the work instead of the thing the work runs on. Take it in first: sleep before the hard decision rather than after it. Let one peer carry a job you could do yourself. Sit out one contest a month on purpose. Eat before you answer the message.

Discipline that skips recovery is borrowing, and the interest is physical. Put maintenance on the calendar before it is needed: fixed bedtime, real meals, one full rest day a week. Track energy like money for one month. Treat the first sign of wear as a warning.

options.text: A body built for effort needs effort to be at peace. Give it a hard weekly outlet, lifting, long walks, manual work. Pair every sitting-heavy day with something physical. When patience runs short, train first and talk after.

Being right is how you stay in charge of yourself. Ship one finished thing to someone above you by their date. Say your plan to someone who can refuse it. Seek Fire, the Order energy. Fire is heat with a job: it burns toward a deadline and gives force a shape. Let it shape what Metal stores.

options.text: Your strength is the kind you make alone, so you measure yourself against your own last best rather than against anyone beside you.
You hold yourself to a standard you would never ask of anyone else, which usually puts your own company ahead of anyone's help.
You bend for nothing and call it strength, and your body keeps that bargain until the day it presents the bill.
